description: This file defines the CalendarHistoryDataWrapper class, which manages a collection of CalendarHistory objects, providing methods to sort them by end date and retrieve specific history entries based on date.

classes.name: CalendarHistoryDataWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for a list of CalendarHistory objects, providing sorted access and retrieval based on date.

methods.name: CalendarHistoryDataWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a set of CalendarHistory objects, converting it into a list and sorting it by end date.

methods.name: getCalendarHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the first CalendarHistory object whose end date is after the specified date.

methods.name: getCalendarHistoryList
methods.description: Returns the internal list of CalendarHistory objects.
